table.name: TLGNC_RAIL_TIMETABLE
table.description: Rail timetable for Crh. Timetable is published by the railway company, tipically once a year especially for Crh. It contains all end-to-end connections between stations used by Crh. The route is unknown. Manual corrections to the timetable can be done by the administrator.

column.name: DEP_RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. Railway station on which the tour starts.

column.name: DEP_TRAIN_NO
column.description: The train that is used for shipping at departure

column.name: DEP_SWITCHING_TIME_MIN
column.description: Time of departure before switching in minutes after midnight. (Stellzeit Abfahrt)

column.name: DEP_TIME_MIN
column.description: Time of departure in minutes after midnight. (Abfahrt)

column.name: ARR_RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. Railway station on which the tour ends.

column.name: ARR_OFFSET_DAYS
column.description: Additional working days between departure time and arrival time. (excludes Saturday, Sunday and public holidays).

column.name: ARR_TRAIN_NO
column.description: The train that is used for shipping on arrival

column.name: ARR_TIME_MIN
column.description: Time of preparation time departure in minutes after midnight. (Ankunft)

column.name: ARR_SWITCHING_TIME_MIN
column.description: Time of arrival after switching in minutes after midnight. (Stellzeit Ankunft)

column.name: TIMETABLE_COMMENT
column.description: A comment that the user can enter. Has no logic attached.
